9.(a)

No of votes got by winner = 54%

No of votes got by loser = 46%

ATQ,

x × 910 × 910 × (54 - 46)% = 1620

questions.q: 10. In an election , 35% of the voters for candidate P whereas 50% of the remaining voted for candidate Q. The remaining voters did not vote. If the different between those who voted for candidate P and those who did not vote was 1000, the number of individuals eligible for casting a vote in that election was:
questions.s:
10.(c)

Let the total number of voters in an election be 100x

No of votes got by candidate P = 100 x × 35% = 35x

Remaining no of votes = 100 x - 35 x = 65x

No of votes got by candidate Q = 65x × 50% = 32.5x

ATQ,

35x - 32.5x = 1000

2.5x = 1000

x =10002.5 = 400

So, the total number of voters in an election = 400×100 = 40,000
